    if parent[i] != i:
        parent[i] = find(parent, parent[i])
    return parent[i]

    xroot = find(parent, x)

        parent[xroot] = yroot
    elif rank[xroot] > rank[yroot]:
        parent[yroot] = xroot
    else:
        parent[yroot] = xroot
        rank[xroot] += 1
